prerequisites: The student knows the types of welds, welding positions, joints marking, causes of welded joints cracking
The student knows the basic welding methods and parameters of the welding processes
The student has knowledge of the fundamentals and applications of soldering, brazing, resistance welding and thermal cutting
The student is able to select the right technology (method) of joining (bonding) and define basic parameters of the process
The student is able to select the right technology (method) of thermal cutting and define basic parameters of the process
The student is able to design a simple bonding process of the product

learning_outcomes.text: Has knowledge of the performance of various welded structures
Knows welding, resistance welding, soldering, brazing and adhesive bonding technologies of different metals and alloys
Has knowledge of use of welding, resistance welding, soldering, brazing and adhesive bonding
Is able to select the right bonding technology
Is able to select the appropriate parameters of welding, soldering, brazing, resistance welding and adhesive bonding
Is able to design bonding process of different types of structures
Searching for information and its critical analysis
Team cooperation on improving methods for the selection of a strategy to optimally solve assigned problems
Objective evaluation of arguments, rational explanations and justifications of own point of view, using knowledge of welding technology

syllabus_topics: Introduction to economics of welding processes
Technological parameters of manual metal arc welding
Technological parameters of TIG welding
Technological parameters of submerged arc welding
Technological parameters MAG/MIG welding
Welding of unalloyed and low-alloy steel
Welding of high-alloy steel
Welding of copper and cast iron alloys
Aluminum and its alloys welded constructions
Welding of pressure vessels
Advanced soldering and brazing technologies
Selected aspects of resistance welding
Structural adhesives, properties and applications
Adhesive technology of engineering materials
Laser welding
Selection of MMA welding parameters
Selection of MIG, MAG, TIG welding parameters
Determination of pre-heating temperature of welded steels
Selection of filler materials for welding high-alloy steels
Influence of welding parameters on the process of resistance weld forming. Evaluation of resistance welded joints.
Advanced soldering and brazing technologies
Adhesive bonding of basic engineering materials
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: For lectures, the concluding grade (P) is equal to the forming grade (F1), which is based on a final test. For laboratories, the concluding grade (P) is the average of the forming grades (F1), which are based on short tests and laboratory reports.
